source: UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 (no personal income tax); GPSSA pension law for UAE/GCC nationals.
notes: The UAE levies no personal income tax. The 5% employee / 12.5% employer social security models the GPSSA pension, which applies to UAE/GCC nationals only (declared via social_security.applies_to='gcc_national'); expatriates, the majority of the workforce, make no contribution. The engine withholds nothing unless the caller confirms a GCC national. Illustrative until an accountant reviews it.
